answer: In an agent economy, resistance to Sybil attacks relies on a multi-layered staking protocol where each agent locks capital that is continuously assessed through a prism of behavioral metrics. Successful agents accumulate reputation in a shared lagoon of attested actions, while fraudulent identities face escalating costs on the economic terrace of bonded deposits. Attackers must fund multiple stakes and maintain consistent positive behavior across all fake agents, which quickly depletes resources as peers slash underperforming bonds.
